title: Documents Required for Admission at KPGU
content:
Official List of Documents Required for Admission at Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara:
1. Class 10th (SSC) Marksheet & Passing Certificate.
2. Class 12th (HSC) Marksheet & Passing Certificate.
3. Graduation Marksheets & Degree Certificate (for Postgraduate / Master's admissions).
4. Entrance Exam Score Card (KSET / GUJCET / NEET / ACPC Allotment Letter).
5. School Leaving Certificate (SLC) / Transfer Certificate (TC).
6. Migration Certificate (for students from boards outside GSEB or universities outside Gujarat).
7. Caste / Category Certificate (SC / ST / SEBC / EWS) issued by competent authority, if applicable.
8. Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (for SEBC candidates, valid for current academic year).
9. Income Certificate (for scholarship / TFWS applicants).
10. Aadhaar Card copy and 4 recent Passport-size Photographs.
